notes:
Quick CRM snapshot - short bullets / call paraphrase.

- Internal stakeholders: CTO (Anders Vik), Head of Security (Marta Ruiz), Product Lead (Sophie Lemaire).
- "Legal will not sign without explicit EU residency clause" — flagged as procurement blocker.
- Next demo scheduled 2025-02-20: Dedicated design review + regional failover policy walkthrough.
